Post Date: December 20, 2024

10:09 am

Join Indian Navy (Nausena Bharti), has released a notification on official website for the recruitment of Executive & Technical Branch Through 10+2 B.Tech Entry Permanent Commission July 2025 batch. Minimum age required is 17 & The Maximum Age Is 19.5 Years. Indian Navy 10+2 Recruitment 2024 : Education Qualification 
  • All candidates who have passed the 12th-grade examination with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM), securing at least 70% marks in each subject from any recognized board in India, are eligible to apply for this recruitment.
  • It is mandatory to have a minimum of 50% marks in English at the 10th and 12th-grade levels.
  • Candidates must also be registered for and appear in the JEEMAIN 2024 entrance examination.

 How To Fill Indian Navy 10+2 Online Form 2024 
  • Interested candidates who wish to apply for the Indian Navy post can submit their application online before 20th December 2024.
  • Use the click here link provided below under important link section to apply directly.
  • Alternatively, visit the official website of Indian Navy to complete the application process online.
  • Make sure to complete the application before the deadline 20th December 2024.

 

Indian Navy 10+2 Recruitment 2024 : Mode Of Selection 
  • SSB Interview
  • Document Verification
  • Medical Examination

 

 Indian Navy 10+2 Recruitment 2024 : Training Details 
  • The chosen candidates will enroll in a four-year B.Tech program in Applied Electronics, Mechanical, or Communication Engineering, based on the Navy’s needs, at the INA, Ezhimala. Upon successful completion of the course, candidates will receive a B.Tech degree from Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU). The Indian Navy will bear the full cost of the training, including books, uniforms, and meals.
